name: p3b-pillars-sun
js: const s = v.outsideMat.uniforms.uSunDir.value; const az = (Math.atan2(s.x, -s.z) * 180 / Math.PI + 360) % 360; v.director.setHeading((az - 90 + 360) % 360); v.state.heading = (az - 90 + 360) % 360; v.state.bankDeg = 0; v.wonders.enabled = true; for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(r)); v.wonders.trigger("pillars", { bearingDeg: az, distKm: 190, reveal: 1, seed: 0.83 }); return 'az ' + az.toFixed(1) + ' alt ' + (Math.asin(s.y) * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(2);
